title: The Participatory Insolvency Paradox: A Forensic Micro-Accounting of Endogenous Extraction and the Liquidation of the Social Commons (1980–2025)

detail.title: The Participatory Insolvency Paradox: A Forensic Micro-Accounting of Endogenous Extraction and the Liquidation of the Social Commons (1980–2025)
detail.abstract:
This paper identifies a profound structural regime shift in global capital formation that has remained obscured by the institutionalized gaslighting of nominal income metrics and "Hedonic" statistical obfuscation. We contend that since the 1980 policy reset, the global economic architecture has endogenously transitioned from a "Market Economy"—where labor could realistically convert into capital—to a Subscription-to-Existence Model. In this paradigm, the "Common Man" (P50) is no longer an economic participant but a Biological Annuity whose productivity is siphoned via Inelastic Participation Infrastructures.

Utilizing a forty-five-year longitudinal dataset across six diverse geographical archetypes—the USA (Financialized), Germany (Social-Fiscal), India (Growth-Extractive), China (State-Managed), Sweden (Redistributive-Moat), and the UAE (Pure Rentier)—we perform a distributional autopsy of the median household balance sheet. We introduce the Participatory Insolvency Model (PIM) to prove that while nominal wages at floating prices appear to rise, the Residual Wealth Potential (RWP) of the P50 has been systematically liquidated.

Our findings demonstrate a Symmetry of Extraction: the liquidation of human leisure (Time) and the monetization of the Social Commons (Participation Tolls) have reached their biological limits. We prove that in 2025, the P50 is structurally prohibited from capital formation because the Cantillon Velocity of assets (Housing/Equity) is endogenously calibrated to outrun wage growth by a factor of 4x to 8x. This research serves as the definitive forensic record of the death of economic autonomy, concluding that the "Common Man" is now merely a cash-flow unit providing labor to service a life he will never own.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了过去45年全球资本形成的结构性转变：经济体系已从"市场经济"转变为"生存订阅模式"，中产阶级不再是经济参与者而是"生物年金"，其财富潜力被系统性清算。
AI.research_question: 全球资本形成结构如何从1980年代政策重置后发生根本性转变？中产阶级（P50）的财富潜力为何被系统性清算？
AI.motivation: 传统名义收入指标和"享乐主义"统计方法掩盖了全球资本形成的结构性转变，需要揭示中产阶级经济自主权丧失的真实状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 生存订阅模式理论；2. 参与性破产模型（PIM）；3. 剩余财富潜力（RWP）概念；4. 坎蒂隆资产速度理论；5. 提取对称性理论。
AI.method: 使用45年纵向数据集，涵盖6种地理原型（美国、德国、印度、中国、瑞典、阿联酋），对中产阶级家庭资产负债表进行分布性尸检分析。
AI.findings: 1. 中产阶级的剩余财富潜力被系统性清算；2. 资产（房地产/股票）的坎蒂隆速度内生性校准为工资增长的4-8倍；3. 2025年中产阶级被结构性禁止资本形成；4. 人类闲暇时间和社会公共资源货币化已达到生物极限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"生存订阅模式"新经济范式；2. 建立参与性破产模型（PIM）；3. 发展剩余财富潜力（RWP）分析框架；4. 完善提取对称性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供全球资本形成结构性转变的法医记录；2. 揭示中产阶级经济自主权丧失的机制；3. 为政策制定者提供重新设计经济架构的依据；4. 帮助理解不同经济体制下的财富分配模式。

title: Foreign Direct Investment Environment and Economic Growth

detail.title: Foreign Direct Investment Environment and Economic Growth
detail.abstract: This paper examines the models of economic growth and the dynamic interaction between models from the Solow Model to New Endogenous Models. Long-term relationship of these models is noticed to have been related in terms of causality. Model comparisons were made to examine their dynamics which is not as complex as reflected. Results that growth is led by endogenous or exogenous factors are not verified to be absolute but relative. Results indicate that FDI affect the economic growth in many developing countries, but there are also many cases (developed countries) that show that economic growth has led to a long term increase of FDI flow. It is also verified that the impact of FDI on the environment is relative, based on the fact that there are exogenous factors that may affect the reduction of externalities. Causal link among FDI, economic growth and their impact on the environment makes the endogenous models be analysed with the dynamics, through which is shown best which is the "cause-consequence" factor, that causes gaps of concepts and practices in economic growth and environmental concerns.

AI.tldr: 该论文从索洛模型到新内生增长模型，探讨了经济增长模型的演变及其动态相互作用。研究发现FDI与经济增长之间存在双向因果关系，FDI对环境的影响是相对的，且存在影响外部性减少的外生因素。
AI.research_question: 经济增长模型（从索洛模型到新内生增长模型）之间的动态相互作用是什么？FDI、经济增长和环境之间的因果关系如何？
AI.motivation: 理解不同经济增长模型之间的关系，以及FDI、经济增长和环境之间的复杂因果关系，以弥合经济增长理论和环境实践之间的概念差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 索洛增长模型（外生增长理论）和新内生增长模型（内生增长理论），关注FDI、经济增长和环境外部性之间的因果关系。
AI.method: 模型比较分析，考察不同经济增长模型的动态关系，分析FDI、经济增长和环境之间的因果关系。
AI.findings: 1. 经济增长由内生或外生因素驱动不是绝对的而是相对的；2. FDI影响许多发展中国家的经济增长，但在发达国家中经济增长也导致FDI长期增加；3. FDI对环境的影响是相对的，存在影响外部性减少的外生因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了经济增长模型之间的动态关系，提出了FDI、经济增长和环境之间的因果关系框架，弥合了经济增长理论和环境实践之间的概念差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于FDI、经济增长和环境之间关系的更细致理解，有助于制定更平衡的经济增长和环境保护政策。

title: Cultural Isomorphism in Financial Education: A Gamified Stochastic Model of Savings Horizons based on the 'Lucha Libre' Metaphor

detail.title: Cultural Isomorphism in Financial Education: A Gamified Stochastic Model of Savings Horizons based on the 'Lucha Libre' Metaphor

declarations.funderStatement: Instituto Politécnico Nacional

detail.abstract:
This software artefact (available for universal access at: https://divulgandolasfinanzas-afk.github.io/Divulgando-las-Finanzas-Games/) presents a gamified behavioural intervention and a stochastic model designed to strengthen long-term savings habits amongst the Mexican population. Grounded in the "Financial Inclusion in Mexico 2025" diagnostic framework , the project addresses the persistent gap between financial access (63% possess formal accounts ) and effective usage , whilst combatting the "lack of financial consciousness" and the cultural irrelevance of traditional educational materials. The core methodology employs a strategy of cultural isomorphism, utilising the iconography of Mexican Lucha Libre. 

This approach reduces the cognitive load for vulnerable populations by linking the abstract concept of saving to a culturally recognised combat system. The simulation models the savings lifecycle through a stochastic combat system where "good" and "bad" manoeuvres simulate financial shocks (income variability vs. unexpected expenses), compelling real-time resource allocation decisions. Users progress through three distinct arenas representing savings temporal horizons (Short-Term/Liquidity, Medium-Term/Security, and Long-Term/Capital Accumulation). The system employs adaptive feedback loops and seeks to mitigate hyperbolic discounting biases and foster resilience in long-term planning. This simulation protocol contributes directly to national strategic axes centred on social inclusion, poverty, and inequality.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个基于墨西哥摔跤文化的游戏化行为干预工具，通过文化同构策略降低认知负荷，使用随机战斗系统模拟储蓄生命周期，帮助墨西哥人口建立长期储蓄习惯。
AI.research_question: 如何通过文化相关的游戏化干预来增强墨西哥人口的长期储蓄习惯，解决金融包容性中"获取与使用"的差距问题？
AI.motivation: 墨西哥存在金融包容性差距：63%人口拥有正式账户但有效使用率低；传统金融教育材料存在"缺乏金融意识"和文化不相关的问题；需要解决社会包容、贫困和不平等问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"墨西哥2025年金融包容性"诊断框架；文化同构理论（使用墨西哥摔跤文化）；行为经济学中的双曲线贴现偏差；认知负荷理论；金融包容性理论。
AI.method: 开发游戏化行为干预软件，采用文化同构策略（墨西哥摔跤图标）；设计随机战斗系统模拟储蓄生命周期（好/坏动作代表财务冲击）；三个竞技场代表不同储蓄时间维度；包含自适应反馈循环。
AI.findings: 该工具通过文化相关的游戏化设计降低了脆弱人群的认知负荷；随机战斗系统有效模拟了收入波动和意外支出等财务冲击；三个竞技场结构帮助用户理解不同时间维度的储蓄策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了文化同构在金融教育中的应用框架；发展了游戏化行为干预的理论模型；为金融包容性研究提供了文化敏感性的方法论贡献；扩展了随机系统在金融行为模拟中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可公开访问的游戏化工具；为墨西哥人口提供了文化相关的金融教育材料；有助于缓解双曲线贴现偏差；支持国家社会包容、减贫和不平等减少的战略目标。

title: Universal Singularity Mechanics (USM v53.6): A Unied Operational Framework for Multi-Domain Manifold Collapse

detail.title: Universal Singularity Mechanics (USM v53.6): A Unied Operational Framework for Multi-Domain Manifold Collapse
detail.abstract: This paper establishes the USM v53.6 architecture, providing denitive mathematical and bibliographical closure for deterministic singularity prediction. We resolve the coupling between informational entropy and structural fatigue by implementing a renormalized L-operator and a regularized Schwarzschild metric[cite: 63, 66]. Using a Peak-Over-Threshold (POT) protocol with Miller-Madow bias correction and Ferro-Segers extremal index estimation, we derive an asymptotic p-value of 6.09 × 10-15 across nancial, seismic, and mechanical manifolds[cite: 62, 64].

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了USM v53.6架构，通过实现重整化的L算子和正则化的史瓦西度规，解决了信息熵与结构疲劳之间的耦合问题，为确定性奇点预测提供了数学和文献上的最终结论。
AI.research_question: 如何建立能够预测确定性奇点的数学架构，并解决信息熵与结构疲劳之间的耦合问题？
AI.motivation: 需要为确定性奇点预测提供数学和文献上的最终结论，解决信息熵与结构疲劳之间的耦合问题，以应用于金融、地震和机械等多个领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于重整化的L算子和正则化的史瓦西度规，结合信息熵理论和结构疲劳理论，建立USM v53.6架构。
AI.method: 使用峰值超越阈值（POT）协议，结合Miller-Madow偏差校正和Ferro-Segers极值指数估计方法，在金融、地震和机械流形上进行验证。
AI.findings: 推导出渐近p值为6.09×10^-15，表明该架构在多个领域都具有统计显著性，能够有效预测确定性奇点。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了USM v53.6架构，为确定性奇点预测提供了完整的数学框架；2. 解决了信息熵与结构疲劳之间的耦合问题；3. 引入了重整化的L算子和正则化的史瓦西度规。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 该架构可应用于金融风险预测；2. 可用于地震预测；3. 在机械工程中可用于结构疲劳预测；4. 提供了一种跨领域的奇点预测方法。

title: India Iceberg Index: Measuring AI Occupational Exposure Across 744 Districts

detail.title: India Iceberg Index: Measuring AI Occupational Exposure Across 744 Districts
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence represents a general-purpose technology targeting cognitive capabilities rather than routine manual labor, yet discourse on AI's workforce impact in India remains concentrated on the information technology sector. We introduce the India Iceberg Index, adapting the Project Iceberg methodology to quantify AI occupational exposure across 744 districts and 36 states and union territories using Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) 2023-24 microdata covering 415,549 individuals. Our analysis reveals that approximately 41.5% of India's wage-weighted employment faces technical exposure to currentgeneration AI systems. The national mean Iceberg Index is 37.74 (SD = 9.38) at the district level, with values ranging from 13.41 to 70.56. Critically, visible technology-sector exposure (Surface Index) constitutes only 0.96% of total employment, while hidden cognitive exposure in administrative, financial, and clerical occupations-the "submerged mass"-extends to districts conventionally considered outside AI's reach. Districts exhibiting maximum "surprise" include The Dangs (Gujarat), Central Delhi, and Chitrakoot (Uttar Pradesh), where Iceberg Index values exceed 60 despite near-zero technology-sector presence. Rural areas show higher mean exposure (49.52) than urban areas (31.46), driven by formal administrative employment in government and banking. Industry concentration analysis using the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index reveals that 55.6% of districts exhibit distributed exposure patterns requiring multi-sector policy coordination. These findings challenge the prevailing "tech problem" framing and suggest that India's service-sector development model faces structural vulnerability as AI capabilities expand into entry-level cognitive work.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了印度冰山指数来衡量AI对印度就业的潜在影响，发现41.5%的工资加权就业面临AI技术暴露，其中技术行业仅占0.96%，大部分暴露来自行政、金融和文书等认知工作，农村地区暴露程度高于城市，挑战了AI影响仅限于技术行业的传统观点。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能对印度劳动力市场的职业暴露程度如何？这种暴露在地区、城乡和行业间如何分布？
AI.motivation: 当前关于AI对印度劳动力影响的讨论过度集中于信息技术行业，忽视了AI作为通用认知技术对其他行业的潜在影响，需要更全面的评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Project Iceberg方法论，区分AI暴露的"表面"（技术行业）和"水下"（认知工作）部分，构建印度冰山指数来衡量AI职业暴露程度。
AI.method: 使用2023-24年周期性劳动力调查（PLFS）微观数据（415,549个个体），将AI职业暴露量化应用于744个地区和36个邦/中央直辖区，计算冰山指数、表面指数和行业集中度（赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数）。
AI.findings: 1. 41.5%的工资加权就业面临AI技术暴露；2. 技术行业暴露仅占0.96%，大部分暴露来自行政、金融和文书工作；3. 农村地区平均暴露（49.52）高于城市（31.46）；4. 55.6%的地区呈现分散的暴露模式，需要多部门政策协调；5. 达格斯（古吉拉特）、中央德里等地区暴露指数高但技术行业几乎为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将冰山方法论应用于发展中国家AI影响评估；2. 揭示AI暴露的"水下"认知工作维度；3. 挑战AI影响仅限于技术行业的理论框架；4. 提出服务部门发展模型的结构性脆弱性概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供地区层面的AI暴露数据；2. 识别需要重点关注的高暴露地区；3. 建议多部门协调的政策应对策略；4. 预警印度服务部门发展模式的结构性风险。

title: Wine Crisis In Mendoza: Structural Deterioration and Spread of Insolvency Risk

detail.title: Wine Crisis In Mendoza: Structural Deterioration and Spread of Insolvency Risk
detail.abstract: Mendoza's wine industry is undergoing a structural crisis that surpasses ordinary economic cycles and exposes a profound deterioration in productive, financial, and territorial sustainability. This article examines how the convergence of overstock, declining consumption, regulatory weakening, market concentration, and financial fragility creates a systemic risk scenario that spreads throughout the entire value chain. Drawing on recent developments-including the flexibilization of the CIU, the expansion of dealcoholized wine, historically low sales levels, and the emergence of significant insolvency proceedings-the analysis highlights the increasing likelihood of contractual breaches and preventive bankruptcy filings. The study contrasts Mendoza's reactive policy responses with the European Union's comprehensive approach, where wine is treated as a strategic territorial, cultural, and socioeconomic asset. It concludes that the absence of robust countercyclical instruments and stable institutional mechanisms, such as a fully operational Wine Bank, exacerbates sectoral fragility and accelerates the diffusion of insolvency risk.

AI.tldr: 门多萨葡萄酒产业正面临超越普通经济周期的结构性危机，暴露了生产、金融和地域可持续性的严重恶化。文章分析了库存过剩、消费下降、监管弱化、市场集中和金融脆弱性等因素如何共同创造了系统性风险，并对比了门多萨的被动政策与欧盟的全面战略方法。
AI.research_question: 门多萨葡萄酒产业的结构性危机如何通过库存过剩、消费下降、监管弱化、市场集中和金融脆弱性的汇聚，创造系统性风险并扩散至整个价值链？
AI.motivation: 门多萨葡萄酒产业正经历超越普通经济周期的结构性危机，暴露出生产、金融和地域可持续性的深刻恶化，需要分析系统性风险的成因和扩散机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、价值链分析、产业危机理论、制度经济学（对比不同政策框架的效果）
AI.method: 基于行业数据的案例分析，包括CIU灵活性调整、无酒精葡萄酒扩张、历史低销售水平、重大破产程序等近期发展，对比门多萨与欧盟的政策响应。
AI.findings: 库存过剩、消费下降、监管弱化、市场集中和金融脆弱性的汇聚创造了系统性风险，增加了合同违约和预防性破产申请的可能性；缺乏健全的反周期工具和稳定制度机制（如完全运作的葡萄酒银行）加剧了行业脆弱性，加速了破产风险的扩散。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了葡萄酒产业系统性风险分析的理论框架，展示了多重因素如何汇聚创造危机；对比了不同政策框架对产业韧性的影响，丰富了制度经济学在农业产业中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为门多萨葡萄酒产业政策制定者提供危机管理建议，强调需要建立反周期工具和稳定制度机制；为其他葡萄酒产区提供预防系统性风险的参考；展示了欧盟将葡萄酒作为战略地域、文化和社会经济资产的综合方法的价值。

title: The U.S. Lunar Resource Extraction Framework: Why Space-Faring Nations Should Adopt the U.S. Legal Interpretation

detail.title: The U.S. Lunar Resource Extraction Framework: Why Space-Faring Nations Should Adopt the U.S. Legal Interpretation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research did not involve human participants or animal subjects; it is a theoretical analysis of existing legal frameworks and international treaties.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This white paper examines the increasing legal and political implications of lunar resource extraction and argues that the United States' domestic framework is the most viable and legally sound model for international adoption. This paper contributes to the literature on international space governance by framing lunar resource extraction as a problem of institutional design, property rights, and investment incentives. While the 1967 Outer Space Treaty (OST) prohibits national appropriation of celestial bodies, it remains ambiguous regarding the ownership of extracted resources. This uncertainty leads to a lack of investment and the potential for territorial disputes. By analyzing the Commercial Space Launch Competitiveness Act of 2015, Executive Order 13914, and the Artemis Accords, this paper demonstrates how the U.S. model facilitates resource ownership without asserting sovereignty claims. Drawing on finance and economics perspectives, the research demonstrates why this framework provides the necessary legal clarity and economic incentives to foster international cooperation and private investment, while overcoming the shortcomings of the 1979 Moon Agreement.

AI.tldr: 本文认为美国国内框架是月球资源开采最可行且合法的国际采纳模式，通过分析美国相关法律和政策，证明该框架能在不主张主权的情况下提供资源所有权，促进国际合作和私人投资。
AI.research_question: 哪种国际框架最适合管理月球资源开采，既能提供法律确定性又不违反《外层空间条约》？
AI.motivation: 月球资源开采的法律和政治影响日益增加，但《外层空间条约》对开采资源所有权存在模糊性，导致投资不足和潜在领土争端，需要建立可行的国际治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度设计理论、产权理论、投资激励理论、国际空间治理理论
AI.method: 法律和政策分析：分析《2015年商业太空发射竞争力法案》、第13914号行政命令和《阿尔忒弥斯协议》；结合金融和经济学视角进行框架评估
AI.findings: 美国框架通过承认资源所有权而非主权主张，提供了必要的法律明确性和经济激励，能够促进国际合作和私人投资，同时克服《月球协定》的缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 将月球资源开采问题重新定义为制度设计、产权和投资激励问题；为国际空间治理文献提供了基于美国模式的替代方案；连接了法律、金融和经济学视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际社会提供了可采纳的法律框架模型；为政策制定者提供了具体的法律工具；为私人投资者提供了法律确定性；促进了《阿尔忒弥斯协议》等国际合作机制的发展。

title: Technological Progress and Per Capita Output: Evidence From Europe and Asia

detail.title: Technological Progress and Per Capita Output: Evidence From Europe and Asia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required as this study is based on publicly available secondary data
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: The paper examines the role of technological advances in the long-run growth of real GDP per capita in two European economies (Germany and the United Kingdom) and two Asian economies (China and Japan) between 1993 and 2023. The analytical model is the Solow growth model with exogenous technological progress. Using data from the World Development Indicators on output, investment and population together with Penn World Table 11.0 data on total factor productivity (TFP), the paper creates uniform time series of real GDP per capita, TFP levels and growth rates, investment shares and population growth. The paper compares the roles of technological progress and capital accumulation using descriptive analysis, growth-accounting-style statistics and simple correlation measures. The findings indicate that as compared to the other three economies, the average GDP per capita growth is significantly greater in China because of the rapid expansion of TFP and high shares of investment. In Japan, TFP growth is very weak and its output per person growth is also very low, although investment is rather high. Germany and the United Kingdom are characterized by moderate growth in per capita that is strongly coupled with modest yet positive growth in TFP. Across all four economies, the correlation between TFP growth and GDP per capita growth is extremely high, which reinforces the Solow model's prediction that technological advancement is a key factor contributing to the long-run gains in living standards. The comparative evidence indicates that similar Solow mechanisms are at work in both the advanced and catching-up economies, but that the path taken by technological development differs radically, giving rise to differences in growth experiences.

AI.tldr: 该论文使用索洛增长模型分析1993-2023年间德国、英国、中国和日本四个经济体中技术进步对人均GDP长期增长的作用。研究发现中国因TFP快速增长和高投资份额而实现最高人均GDP增长，日本TFP增长微弱导致增长缓慢，德英两国则呈现适度增长与TFP正增长紧密相关。所有经济体中TFP增长与人均GDP增长高度相关，验证了索洛模型关于技术进步是长期生活水平提升关键因素的预测。
AI.research_question: 技术进步在德国、英国、中国和日本这四个经济体（1993-2023年）人均实际GDP长期增长中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 比较不同发展阶段经济体（两个欧洲发达经济体：德国和英国；两个亚洲经济体：中国和日本）中技术进步对经济增长的贡献，检验索洛增长模型在不同经济环境下的适用性，理解技术进步路径差异如何导致不同的增长经验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 索洛增长模型（外生技术进步版本），强调技术进步是长期经济增长的关键驱动力，资本积累在稳态增长中作用有限。
AI.method: 使用世界发展指标和Penn World Table 11.0数据构建统一时间序列（人均实际GDP、TFP水平及增长率、投资份额、人口增长），采用描述性分析、增长核算式统计和简单相关性测量，比较技术进步和资本积累的作用。
AI.findings: 1. 中国人均GDP增长最高，源于TFP快速扩张和高投资份额；2. 日本TFP增长非常微弱，人均产出增长很低，尽管投资较高；3. 德英两国人均增长适中，与适度但正的TFP增长紧密相关；4. 所有四个经济体中，TFP增长与人均GDP增长相关性极高，验证索洛模型预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证索洛增长模型在发达经济体和追赶型经济体中的适用性，证明相似的增长机制在不同发展阶段都起作用，但技术进步路径存在根本差异，这解释了增长经验的不同。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证证据，强调技术进步对长期经济增长的重要性，特别是对追赶型经济体（如中国）的启示，以及投资与TFP增长的协同作用对增长绩效的影响。

title: Coastal Property Value Dynamics and Offshore Wind Development: A Hedonic Analysis of Market Responses in New Jersey

detail.title: Coastal Property Value Dynamics and Offshore Wind Development: A Hedonic Analysis of Market Responses in New Jersey

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: written consent
declarations.funderStatement: Self-Funded

detail.abstract:
This study investigates the relationship between offshore wind energy development and coastal residential property values, employing New Jersey as a case study during the critical expansion period of 2010-2024. As the United States pursues ambitious renewable energy targets, understanding how offshore wind installations affect nearby communities' economic interests has become increasingly urgent. Despite growing policy relevance, empirical research on property value impacts in the U.S. context remains limited, creating a significant gap in knowledge that this study addresses.

Employing a hedonic pricing framework integrated with a quasi-experimental difference-in-differences design and spatial econometric techniques, this study analyzes 47,832 residential transactions drawn from Zillow ZTRAX data and county assessor records across three New Jersey coastal counties. The methodology addresses spatial autocorrelation, omitted variable bias, and temporal confounders that have limited prior research. Treatment and control groups are defined based on visibility (viewshed) analysis and distance to offshore wind installations, with particular attention to the Ocean Wind 1 project.

Results indicate a statistically significant negative effect of approximately 2.8% on property values for homes within the viewshed of offshore wind developments. The analysis reveals a pronounced distance-decay pattern, with effects concentrated within 15-20 kilometers of installations and dissipating rapidly beyond this threshold. Notably, temporal analysis demonstrates that construction-phase impacts peak at approximately 5.2% but attenuate to roughly 1.5% during the operational phase, suggesting market adaptation over time. Waterfront and ocean-view properties experience disproportionate effects compared to inland coastal properties.

These findings contribute to hedonic pricing theory by documenting how aesthetic externalities from renewable energy infrastructure are capitalized into property values. Practically, the results inform compensation frameworks, setback policies, and community benefit agreements. The evidence suggests that while property value concerns warrant acknowledgment, they should be weighed against substantial climate benefits and may be partially addressed through thoughtful project design and stakeholder engagement.

AI.tldr: 本研究以新泽西州为例，分析了2010-2024年期间海上风电开发对沿海住宅物业价值的影响。研究发现，位于风电项目视野范围内的房产价值平均下降约2.8%，影响范围集中在15-20公里内，且建设阶段影响最大（5.2%），运营阶段减弱至1.5%。
AI.research_question: 海上风电开发如何影响沿海住宅物业价值？这种影响是否随距离、时间和房产类型而变化？
AI.motivation: 美国追求可再生能源目标，但缺乏关于海上风电对沿海社区经济影响（特别是物业价值）的实证研究，存在知识空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特征价格理论（hedonic pricing framework），结合空间计量经济学技术，分析可再生能源基础设施的美学外部性如何资本化到物业价值中。
AI.method: 准实验双重差分设计结合空间计量技术，分析47,832个住宅交易数据（来自Zillow ZTRAX和县评估记录），处理组基于视野分析和距离定义，控制空间自相关和遗漏变量偏差。
AI.findings: 1) 风电项目视野范围内的房产价值下降约2.8%；2) 距离衰减效应明显，影响集中在15-20公里内；3) 建设阶段影响最大（5.2%），运营阶段减弱至1.5%；4) 水景和海景房产受影响更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了特征价格理论，记录了可再生能源基础设施的美学外部性如何资本化到物业价值中，为环境外部性定价提供新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为补偿框架、退让政策、社区利益协议提供依据，建议通过项目设计和利益相关者参与来缓解负面影响，同时权衡气候效益。

title: The Social Construction of Wind Energy Risk: A Mixed-Methods Analysis of Community Opposition Formation and Information Dynamics in U.S. Offshore Wind Development

detail.title: The Social Construction of Wind Energy Risk: A Mixed-Methods Analysis of Community Opposition Formation and Information Dynamics in U.S. Offshore Wind Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: Written Consent
declarations.funderStatement: Self-Funded

detail.abstract: This explanatory sequential mixed-methods study investigated the social construction of wind energy risk and the formation of community opposition to offshore wind development in the United States, focusing on New Jersey's coastal communities. The research addressed a critical gap in understanding how risk perceptions form and spread in the context of the nation's ambitious offshore wind deployment targets and recent high-profile project cancellations. Grounded in pragmatist epistemology, the study integrated quantitative survey data (N = 412) from coastal residents with qualitative data from semi-structured interviews (n = 28) and social media analysis (7,026 posts). Research questions examined: (a) factors predicting individual-level opposition, (b) information networks and social media dynamics shaping risk perceptions, and (c) the role of procedural justice in acceptance outcomes. Hierarchical multiple regression revealed that the model explained 61.4% of variance in opposition, with visual impact concerns (β = .31), property value concerns (β = .24), and procedural justice perceptions (β = -.24) emerging as the strongest predictors. Findings revealed that offshore wind opposition exhibits a distinctive predictor profile emphasizing visual and property concerns over the health and noise concerns that dominate onshore contexts. Social media has become the primary information source for 93% of interview participants, creating an information ecosystem structurally favoring opposition narratives, with 47.3% of opposition posts containing verifiable misinformation. Procedural justice perceptions partially mediated the relationship between trust in developers and opposition, with 86% of interview participants perceiving engagement processes as performative rather than genuine. The study contributes an Integrated Model of Offshore Wind Opposition Formation (IMOWOF) synthesizing risk perception, procedural justice, place attachment, and information dynamics. Implications include recommendations for enhanced engagement strategies, misinformation counter-messaging, and policy frameworks that address the social dimensions of energy transition. These findings are essential for achieving deployment targets while maintaining democratic legitimacy and community wellbeing.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用解释性顺序混合方法，调查了美国新泽西州沿海社区对海上风电风险的社会建构及社区反对的形成机制。研究发现视觉影响、财产价值担忧和程序正义感知是反对的最强预测因素，社交媒体成为主要信息源但存在大量错误信息，程序正义感知在开发商信任与反对之间起部分中介作用。
AI.research_question: 1) 预测个人层面反对海上风电的因素是什么？2) 信息网络和社交媒体动态如何塑造风险认知？3) 程序正义在接纳结果中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 填补理解在美国雄心勃勃的海上风电部署目标和近期高调项目取消背景下，风险认知如何形成和传播的关键研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实用主义认识论、风险感知理论、程序正义理论、地方依恋理论、信息动态理论
AI.method: 解释性顺序混合方法：定量调查（N=412名沿海居民）、半结构化访谈（n=28）、社交媒体分析（7,026条帖子）
AI.findings: 1) 分层多元回归显示模型解释了61.4%的反对方差，视觉影响担忧(β=.31)、财产价值担忧(β=.24)和程序正义感知(β=-.24)是最强预测因素；2) 海上风电反对具有独特预测特征，强调视觉和财产担忧而非陆上风电主导的健康和噪音担忧；3) 93%访谈参与者将社交媒体作为主要信息来源，47.3%反对帖子包含可验证错误信息；4) 程序正义感知部分中介开发商信任与反对之间的关系，86%访谈参与者认为参与过程是表演性而非真诚的。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了综合风险感知、程序正义、地方依恋和信息动态的海上风电反对形成整合模型(IMOWOF)
AI.practical_contributions: 为增强参与策略、错误信息反制信息传递以及解决能源转型社会维度的政策框架提供建议，对实现部署目标同时保持民主合法性和社区福祉至关重要

title: Supreme Court Narrows ESIC's Section 45A Power: Draws a Hard Line on Misuse

detail.title: Supreme Court Narrows ESIC's Section 45A Power: Draws a Hard Line on Misuse
detail.abstract: The Supreme Court in M/s Carborandum Universal Ltd. v. ESI Corporation (2025 INSC 1455) delivers a decisive reminder that welfare legislation cannot be enforced by bypassing statutory safeguards. While reaffirming the beneficial nature of the ESI Act, the Court firmly holds that Section 45A is not a convenient alternative to adjudication under Section 75, but an exceptional power triggered only by non-production of records or obstruction. This judgment is essential reading for employers, compliance professionals, and labour law practitioners navigating ESI disputes.

AI.tldr: 最高法院在Carborandum Universal Ltd.诉ESI Corporation案中明确，福利立法不能绕过法定保障来执行，强调第45A条是例外权力而非第75条裁决的便捷替代方案。
AI.research_question: 在ESI法案下，第45A条作为行政权力的适用范围和限制是什么？福利立法能否通过绕过法定程序来执行？
AI.motivation: 澄清ESI法案中行政权力与司法裁决之间的界限，防止福利立法被滥用为绕过正当程序的工具，确保雇主权利与员工福利保护的平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政法原则（比例原则、正当程序）、福利立法解释理论、法定权力限制理论、司法审查原则。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、判例法研究、最高法院判决解释、法律原则应用分析。
AI.findings: 1. 第45A条是例外权力，仅在记录未提供或存在阻碍时触发；2. 不能作为第75条裁决的便捷替代方案；3. 福利立法不能通过绕过法定保障来执行；4. 必须平衡雇主权利与员工福利保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了福利立法执行中行政权力与司法程序的界限，发展了福利立法解释理论，强化了法定程序保障在福利执行中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为雇主、合规专业人士和劳动法律师提供了明确的ESl争议处理指南，防止行政权力滥用，确保争议解决程序的正当性。

title: The Export Intelligence Paradox Measuring Anti-Fragile Export Intelligence Under Non-Ergodic Risk

detail.title: The Export Intelligence Paradox Measuring Anti-Fragile Export Intelligence Under Non-Ergodic Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial, professional, or personal interests that could have influenced the research, interpretation, or conclusions of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, patients, clinical trials, surveys, interviews, or the use of identifiable personal data. The research is based entirely on secondary data, publicly available datasets, institutional reports, and theoretical and policy analysis. Accordingly, formal ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This study does not involve any clinical trials or medical interventions.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled export intelligence systems are increasingly used by governments, export promotion agencies, and firms to guide internationalisation decisions. These systems are commonly evaluated using predictive accuracy, expected-value optimisation, and short-term performance metrics. Despite their widespread adoption, export concentration remains persistent in many small open economies, and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) continue to experience irreversible export failure following exposure to regulatory, institutional, or geopolitical shocks. This paper advances the literature by formally operationalising Anti-Fragile Export Intelligence (AFEI) for decision-making under non-ergodic risk, where outcomes are path-dependent, losses are often irreversible, and time averages diverge from ensemble averages. Building on the Export Intelligence Paradox, the paper introduces the AFEI Index (AFEI-I)-a composite metric designed to evaluate how export intelligence systems convert volatility and failure into improved future decision quality. The paper derives testable hypotheses and presents a toy empirical illustration calibrated to the New Zealand export context to demonstrate feasibility using observable organisational and institutional indicators. The framework reframes evaluation away from forecast accuracy toward adaptive learning capacity, with implications for export policy design, AI governance, and productivity strategy in small open economies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出抗脆弱出口智能（AFEI）框架，用于评估AI出口智能系统在非遍历性风险下的决策质量，将评估重点从预测准确性转向适应性学习能力。
AI.research_question: 如何评估AI出口智能系统在非遍历性风险环境下的决策质量？如何设计抗脆弱出口智能（AFEI）框架来帮助出口决策？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI出口智能系统被广泛使用，但许多小型开放经济体出口集中度仍然很高，中小企业在面临监管、制度或地缘政治冲击时仍会遭受不可逆的出口失败。现有评估方法（预测准确性、期望值优化、短期绩效指标）不足以应对非遍历性风险环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 抗脆弱出口智能（AFEI）框架，基于出口智能悖论，针对非遍历性风险环境（结果具有路径依赖性、损失不可逆、时间平均与集合平均发散）。
AI.method: 提出AFEI指数（AFEI-I）作为复合指标，评估出口智能系统如何将波动性和失败转化为改进的未来决策质量。推导可检验假设，并以新西兰出口环境为背景进行玩具实证说明，使用可观察的组织和制度指标。
AI.findings: AFEI框架可行，能够使用可观察指标进行评估。框架将评估重点从预测准确性转向适应性学习能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 正式操作化抗脆弱出口智能（AFEI）概念，引入AFEI指数，为在非遍历性风险环境下的出口决策提供理论框架，扩展了出口智能评估的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 对小型开放经济体的出口政策设计、AI治理和生产力战略具有启示意义。帮助政府和出口促进机构改进AI出口智能系统的评估标准，提高中小企业的抗脆弱性。

title: The Jurisprudential Evolution of Alternative Dispute Resolution in India: A Critical Analysis of Statutory Frameworks and Judicial Precedents

detail.title: The Jurisprudential Evolution of Alternative Dispute Resolution in India: A Critical Analysis of Statutory Frameworks and Judicial Precedents
detail.abstract: Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) has emerged as a fundamental component of modern justice delivery systems, responding to the growing inefficiencies of traditional litigation. In India, ADR has evolved from a voluntary alternative into a legislatively encouraged and judicially endorsed mechanism for dispute settlement. This article undertakes a comprehensive doctrinal analysis of the jurisprudential development of ADR in India, with particular emphasis on the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. It examines the constitutional foundations of ADR, especially Article 39A of the Constitution of India, and analyses the mandatory nature of judicial referral under Section 8 of the 1996 Act. Through an in-depth examination of landmark Supreme Court judgments such as P. Ananda Gajapati Raju v. P.V.G. Raju and Booz Allen & Hamilton Inc. v. SBI Home Finance Ltd., the article explores the concept of arbitrability and the distinction between rights in personam and rights in rem. The study concludes that Indian jurisprudence has adopted a pro-ADR approach while preserving judicial oversight in matters involving public interest, thereby maintaining a balance between efficiency and justice.

AI.tldr: 本文通过教义分析方法，系统研究了印度替代性争议解决（ADR）的法学发展，特别是1996年《仲裁与调解法》，分析了ADR的宪法基础、司法转介的强制性以及仲裁性概念，认为印度法学采取了支持ADR的立场，同时在涉及公共利益的事务中保留司法监督。
AI.research_question: 印度替代性争议解决（ADR）的法学发展轨迹是什么？特别是如何通过1996年《仲裁与调解法》和相关宪法条款（如第39A条）以及最高法院判例来平衡ADR的效率与司法监督之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 传统诉讼日益低效，ADR已成为现代司法体系的重要组成部分。在印度，ADR已从自愿选择发展为立法鼓励和司法认可的争议解决机制，需要系统研究其法学发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 替代性争议解决理论；2. 仲裁性理论；3. 对人权（rights in personam）与对物权（rights in rem）的区分；4. 司法监督与ADR效率平衡理论；5. 宪法第39A条关于司法正义可及性的原则。
AI.method: 教义分析法（doctrinal analysis），深入分析立法文本（特别是1996年《仲裁与调解法》第8条）、宪法条款（第39A条）以及最高法院判例（如P. Ananda Gajapati Raju案和Booz Allen案）。
AI.findings: 1. 印度ADR已从自愿机制发展为立法鼓励和司法认可的正式争议解决途径；2. 宪法第39A条为ADR提供了宪法基础；3. 第8条规定的司法转介具有强制性；4. 最高法院通过判例明确了仲裁性概念和对人权/对物权的区分；5. 印度法学在支持ADR的同时保留了涉及公共利益的司法监督。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 系统构建了印度ADR法学发展的理论框架；2. 阐明了ADR与宪法原则的关系；3. 发展了仲裁性理论在印度语境下的应用；4. 提出了效率与司法监督平衡的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为法律从业者提供了ADR适用的明确指导；2. 帮助法院在转介ADR时保持一致性；3. 为立法者完善ADR制度提供参考；4. 促进争议解决效率同时保障司法正义。

title: The Economics of AI Overuse: Hidden Costs and Externalities of a "Free" Technology
affiliations: and Shenzhen University - College of Economics

detail.title: The Economics of AI Overuse: Hidden Costs and Externalities of a "Free" Technology

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper documents a structural market failure in the deployment of Generative AI: "overuse." We argue that the current "freemium" business model, which reduces the marginal private cost of usage to near zero, functions as a "Reverse Pigouvian tax" that effectively subsidizes the input generating information pollution. We isolate this mechanism through a two-stage research design combining a controlled experiment with a microeconomic model. First, using a dataset of 200 professional accounting tasks and a suite of 17 Large Language Models, we map an empirically derived marginal error cost curve. We find that error rates in dynamic, rule-intensive domains are three times higher than in stable, principle-based domains (61% vs. 20%), with significantly higher economic severity (p < .001). Second, identifying this convex cost structure, we demonstrate that when usage is subsidized and production is opaque, rational agents are incentivized to extend AI usage beyond the social optimum. The findings suggest that without institutional interventions—such as risk-adjusted progressive pricing or strict liability—the decoupling of private benefits from social costs leads to a deadweight loss characterized by systemic resource waste and information degradation.

AI.tldr: 论文发现生成式AI存在"过度使用"的市场失灵问题。当前的"免费增值"商业模式将边际私人成本降至接近零，相当于"反向庇古税"，补贴了产生信息污染的输入。研究发现动态规则密集型领域的错误率是稳定原则性领域的三倍（61% vs 20%），且经济严重性更高。当使用被补贴且生产不透明时，理性代理人会过度使用AI，导致社会福利损失。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI部署中存在什么样的结构性市场失灵？具体来说，当前的商业模式如何导致"过度使用"问题，以及这种过度使用如何造成社会福利损失？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的"免费增值"商业模式将边际私人成本降至接近零，这可能导致用户过度使用AI，产生信息污染和社会成本，但私人成本与社会成本之间存在脱节，需要研究这种市场失灵机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 市场失灵理论：外部性和公共物品问题；2. 庇古税理论：反向应用，补贴导致过度消费；3. 信息经济学：信息污染和信号质量下降；4. 微观经济学：边际成本曲线和最优资源配置。
AI.method: 两阶段研究设计：第一阶段使用200个专业会计任务数据集和17个大语言模型，通过控制实验绘制经验边际错误成本曲线；第二阶段基于凸成本结构建立微观经济模型，分析补贴使用和不透明生产下的理性代理人行为。
AI.findings: 1. 动态规则密集型领域的错误率是稳定原则性领域的三倍（61% vs 20%），经济严重性显著更高（p < .001）；2. 当使用被补贴且生产不透明时，理性代理人会将AI使用扩展到社会最优水平之外；3. 私人收益与社会成本脱节导致系统性资源浪费和信息质量下降的福利损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"反向庇古税"概念，解释免费增值商业模式如何补贴信息污染；2. 识别生成式AI部署中的结构性市场失灵机制；3. 建立AI过度使用的微观经济模型，分析补贴和不透明性如何扭曲激励。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议制度干预措施：风险调整渐进定价或严格责任制度；2. 为政策制定者提供实证依据，说明需要监管AI使用以避免社会福利损失；3. 为企业设计更优的AI定价和使用策略提供指导。

title: Circumventing Tariffs: The Anatomy of Supply Chain Rerouting
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - CUHK Business School, Indian School of Business and Indian School of Business

detail.title: Circumventing Tariffs: The Anatomy of Supply Chain Rerouting
detail.abstract: We examine the physical anatomy of regulatory arbitrage in global supply chains. Using a novel methodology that isolates ``minimal-processing'' transactions from genuine exports, we find that the rerouting of Chinese goods through Mexico increased by 75 percent following the 2018 US--China trade war. The response is driven by incumbent firms adding tariffed products to their portfolio, is concentrated among differentiated goods, and materializes only under a high tariff wedge. Crucially, we show that this arbitrage drives endogenous investment in physical logistics. Using satellite imagery, we detect a policy-induced expansion in border warehousing, with rerouting firms clustering closer to customs posts than typical exporters.

AI.tldr: 本文研究全球供应链中的监管套利现象，通过分析中美贸易战后中国商品经墨西哥转口到美国的情况，发现这种"最小加工"转口交易增加了75%，并推动了边境物流基础设施的投资。
AI.research_question: 中美贸易战如何影响全球供应链中的监管套利行为？这种监管套利如何驱动物理物流基础设施的投资？
AI.motivation: 理解贸易政策变化如何影响企业的供应链决策，特别是企业如何通过监管套利规避关税，以及这种套利行为如何塑造物理供应链基础设施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管套利理论、供应链管理理论、贸易政策效应理论、企业应对策略理论
AI.method: 采用新颖的方法论区分"最小加工"交易和真实出口；使用卫星图像分析边境仓储设施扩张；分析中美贸易战前后中国商品经墨西哥转口到美国的数据
AI.findings: 1. 中美贸易战后，中国商品经墨西哥转口到美国的"最小加工"交易增加了75%；2. 这种套利主要由现有企业将受关税影响的产品加入其产品组合驱动；3. 主要集中在差异化商品上；4. 只有在高关税差距下才会出现；5. 监管套利推动了边境物流基础设施的投资，特别是边境仓储设施的扩张
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为监管套利理论提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了贸易政策如何通过供应链重组影响企业行为；3. 提出了物理供应链基础设施作为监管套利内生结果的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了贸易政策实际效果的证据；2. 帮助企业理解供应链重组策略；3. 为物流和仓储投资者提供了市场机会的洞察

title: BRI: An Era of New Arab-China Engagement

detail.title: BRI: An Era of New Arab-China Engagement
detail.abstract: The chapter's primary focus is to examine China's BRI in different regions such as North Africa, the Levant, and the Gulf to provide a holistic picture of China's BRI and its implementation in the Arab World. It also highlights concerns of China and Arab World's regarding the BRI and how the role of the United States in the Arab World as the primary security provider challenges China's aspirations to implement the BRI.

AI.tldr: 该章节主要研究中国"一带一路"倡议在阿拉伯世界不同区域（北非、黎凡特、海湾地区）的实施情况，分析中国与阿拉伯国家对"一带一路"的关注点，以及美国作为主要安全提供者在阿拉伯世界的角色如何挑战中国实施"一带一路"的愿望。
AI.research_question: 中国"一带一路"倡议在阿拉伯世界不同区域（北非、黎凡特、海湾地区）的实施情况如何？中国和阿拉伯国家对"一带一路"有哪些关注点？美国作为阿拉伯世界主要安全提供者的角色如何挑战中国实施"一带一路"的愿望？
AI.motivation: 需要全面了解中国"一带一路"倡议在阿拉伯世界的实施情况，分析中国与阿拉伯国家在"一带一路"合作中的相互关切，以及地缘政治因素（特别是美国在阿拉伯世界的安全角色）对"一带一路"实施的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治理论、国际关系理论（特别是大国竞争和区域安全架构）、发展合作理论、基础设施投资与区域一体化理论。
AI.method: 区域比较分析（北非、黎凡特、海湾地区）、案例研究、政策分析、文献综述、地缘政治分析。
AI.findings: 1. "一带一路"在阿拉伯世界不同区域的实施存在差异；2. 中国和阿拉伯国家对"一带一路"各有特定关切；3. 美国在阿拉伯世界的安全提供者角色构成了对中国"一带一路"实施的重要挑战；4. 地缘政治竞争影响基础设施合作和发展倡议。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了"一带一路"倡议的区域实施差异研究；2. 深化了对大国竞争背景下发展合作的理解；3. 提出了安全架构与发展倡议相互作用的分析框架；4. 贡献于新兴大国与传统大国在第三区域互动的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供"一带一路"在阿拉伯世界实施的区域差异分析；2. 帮助理解中国与阿拉伯国家在"一带一路"合作中的关切点；3. 揭示美国安全角色对"一带一路"实施的实际影响；4. 为相关企业和投资者提供区域风险评估参考。

detail.abstract: This report sets out the purpose and structure of Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND) policy, how it gets made and evaluated, how it sits in relation to broader context, and what we know about the outcomes for pupils with SEND across 14 jurisdictions (England, Scotland, Northern Ireland, Wales, Ireland, France, the Netherlands, Finland, Estonia, Poland, Japan, Singapore, New Zealand, Ontario.)

AI.tldr: 本报告系统分析了14个司法管辖区特殊教育需求与残疾（SEND）政策的目的、结构、制定与评估过程、与更广泛背景的关系，以及SEND学生的教育成果。
AI.research_question: 不同司法管辖区特殊教育需求与残疾（SEND）政策的目的、结构、制定过程、评估机制、与更广泛教育背景的关系以及SEND学生的教育成果有何异同？
AI.motivation: 特殊教育需求与残疾（SEND）政策对保障教育公平至关重要，但不同司法管辖区的政策设计和实施效果存在差异，需要系统比较分析以促进政策改进和国际经验交流。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育政策分析框架、比较教育研究理论、特殊教育政策评估理论、教育公平与包容性教育理论。
AI.method: 多司法管辖区比较研究，涵盖14个司法管辖区（英格兰、苏格兰、北爱尔兰、威尔士、爱尔兰、法国、荷兰、芬兰、爱沙尼亚、波兰、日本、新加坡、新西兰、安大略省）的政策文件分析、制度比较和成果评估。
AI.findings: 报告将揭示不同司法管辖区SEND政策的多样性、政策制定与评估机制的差异、政策与更广泛教育背景的整合程度，以及SEND学生教育成果的跨国比较结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了跨司法管辖区的特殊教育政策比较分析框架，丰富了比较教育研究和特殊教育政策理论，为理解不同制度背景下教育包容性政策的实施提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了国际SEND政策实践的经验参考，帮助识别有效政策要素，促进各国特殊教育政策的改进和优化，最终提升SEND学生的教育成果和包容性教育质量。

title: Liberty / Freedom and the Russian Federation : Translation from Russian publication

detail.title: Liberty / Freedom and the Russian Federation : Translation from Russian publication

publicationDetails.detailsText:
Reference for the article in Russian:
Крупкин П.Л. Свобода и РФ // Вопросы национализма, 2017, 1(29), с.20-24

detail.abstract: The article overviews all known approaches to formalization of a problem of Liberty / Freedom (« Liberty from », « Liberty for », « being for her/his own sake, not a other's », « absence of sovereign other », individual freeing in a context of the Master-Slave Dialectics, Social Freedom) and problems of emancipation (« restricting privileges of upper class minorities », « giving privileges to marginalized minorities – affirmative actions »). Then, the article discusses a version of formalization of level of social freedom through comparison of what is allowed for an individuals in the society with what is allowed for «a sheep in herd »: each additional degree of freedom gives unit in plus, each additional restriction gives unit in minus. The proposed model was tested for a case of the post-Soviet transit, when the level of freedom evolved from minus two for the USSR up to plus two for the contemporary Russian Federation. It also shows the ways for further emancipation of people in Russia in « politically easy version » - i.e. without essential change of its political system.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了自由/解放问题的所有已知形式化方法，提出了通过比较个体在社会中允许的行为与"羊群中的羊"的允许行为来量化社会自由度的模型，并以苏联到俄罗斯联邦的转型为例进行测试。
AI.research_question: 如何形式化地衡量社会自由度？苏联到俄罗斯联邦转型期间的社会自由度如何变化？如何在俄罗斯现有政治体系下进一步解放人民？
AI.motivation: 自由和解放概念在政治哲学中具有多种解释，需要系统性的形式化方法来量化社会自由度，特别是分析后苏联转型期的社会变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自由理论（"免于...的自由"、"为了...的自由"）、解放理论、主奴辩证法、社会自由概念、特权再分配理论（限制上层少数特权 vs 赋予边缘少数特权）。
AI.method: 文献综述所有已知自由/解放形式化方法，提出量化模型：将个体在社会中允许的行为与"羊群中的羊"比较，每增加一度自由得+1分，每增加一项限制得-1分，以后苏联转型为案例研究。
AI.findings: 苏联时期社会自由度得分为-2，当代俄罗斯联邦得分为+2，显示转型期间自由度显著提升。模型识别了在现有政治体系下进一步解放人民的"政治简易版本"路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 系统综述自由/解放形式化方法；2) 提出基于"羊群比较"的社会自由度量化模型；3) 将抽象自由概念转化为可操作测量指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供评估社会自由度的实用工具；2) 识别俄罗斯进一步解放的具体路径；3) 为政策制定者提供在不改变政治体系前提下提升自由度的方案。

title:
The Export Intelligence Paradox 
Measuring Anti-Fragile Export Intelligence Under Non-Ergodic Risk

detail.title:
The Export Intelligence Paradox 
Measuring Anti-Fragile Export Intelligence Under Non-Ergodic Risk

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial interests, personal relationships, or competing interests that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on conceptual analysis, theoretical modeling, and secondary data sources. It does not involve human participants, personal data, experiments, or clinical trials. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was independently conducted by the author.

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled export intelligence systems are increasingly used by governments, export promotion agencies, and firms to guide internationalisation decisions. These systems are commonly evaluated using predictive accuracy, expected-value optimisation, and short-term performance metrics. Despite their widespread adoption, export concentration remains persistent in many small open economies, and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) continue to experience irreversible export failure following exposure to regulatory, institutional, or geopolitical shocks. This paper advances the literature by formally operationalising Anti-Fragile Export Intelligence (AFEI) for decision-making under non-ergodic risk, where outcomes are path-dependent, losses are often irreversible, and time averages diverge from ensemble averages. Building on the Export Intelligence Paradox, the paper introduces the AFEI Index (AFEI-I)-a composite metric designed to evaluate how export intelligence systems convert volatility and failure into improved future decision quality. The paper derives testable hypotheses and presents a toy empirical illustration calibrated to the New Zealand export context to demonstrate feasibility using observable organisational and institutional indicators. The framework reframes evaluation away from forecast accuracy toward adaptive learning capacity, with implications for export policy design, AI governance, and productivity strategy in small open economies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出抗脆弱出口智能（AFEI）框架，用于评估AI出口智能系统在非遍历风险下的决策质量，强调将波动和失败转化为未来决策改进的能力，而非传统预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何评估AI出口智能系统在非遍历风险环境下的决策质量？如何将系统波动和失败转化为未来决策改进？
AI.motivation: 尽管AI出口智能系统广泛使用，但许多小型开放经济体出口集中度依然持续，中小企业在面临监管、制度或地缘政治冲击时仍遭遇不可逆的出口失败。传统基于预测准确性、期望值优化和短期绩效的评估方法存在局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于出口智能悖论，构建抗脆弱出口智能（AFEI）理论框架，强调在非遍历风险（结果路径依赖、损失不可逆、时间平均与集合平均发散）环境下的决策质量评估。
AI.method: 提出AFEI指数（AFEI-I）作为复合评估指标，推导可检验假设，并以新西兰出口环境为背景进行玩具实证说明，使用可观测的组织和制度指标展示可行性。
AI.findings: AFEI框架将评估重点从预测准确性转向自适应学习能力，展示了如何将波动和失败转化为未来决策质量改进的可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）正式操作化抗脆弱出口智能概念；2）引入AFEI指数评估出口智能系统；3）为出口智能悖论提供理论扩展；4）为非遍历风险下的决策理论做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为出口政策设计提供新评估框架；2）对AI治理有启示意义；3）为小型开放经济体的生产力战略提供指导；4）帮助中小企业更好应对不可逆风险。

title: Machine Learning (Deep) Application to Portfolio Allocation

detail.title: Machine Learning (Deep) Application to Portfolio Allocation
detail.abstract: This study presents a broad portfolio optimization model that incorporates advanced deep learning architectures with traditional financial models to improve risk-adjusted performance. Historical data from 2015 to 2023 across a variety of asset classes were used, including equities, Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), and bonds. This research further examines the structural capabilities and predictive power of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), Transformers, and Autoencoders. The suggested models combine covariance estimation, forecasting return, dynamic asset allocation, and dimensionality reduction. Composite models such as Transformer+GNN and Autoencoder+DRL are also explored to leverage both relational and temporal structures in market data. Performance is evaluated through a robust backtesting method, comparing volatility, cumulative return, maximum drawdown, annualized return, and Sharpe ratio across seven strategies, among which are Equal-Weighted, 60/40 allocations, and Mean-Variance Optimization (MVO). Empirical outcomes show that composite learning models demonstrate better stability and risk control, with Transformer+GNN attaining the lowest volatility and drawdown. Mean-Variance Optimization with well-calibrated inputs recorded the maximum cumulative return and Sharpe ratio. Standalone DRL fell short of expectation due to limited structural awareness. The Autoencoder echoed the behaviour of Equal-Weight allocations, which underscores the significance of dynamic policy learning. The results obtained conform to existing literature highlighting the value of relational modeling and feature compression in financial applications. The result of Mean-Variance Optimization in this context challenges previous critiques by establishing that traditional methods retain competitiveness when paired with correct predictive inputs. This study supports the current discourse on data-driven portfolio construction and proposes that the incorporation of deep learning and financial theory can produce robust and adaptive investment strategies. Future study may examine application of latent financial representations within traditional optimization frameworks to further advance robustness and scalability.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一个结合深度学习与传统金融模型的广泛投资组合优化框架，使用2015-2023年多资产数据，评估GNN、DRL、Transformer和Autoencoder等架构，发现复合模型（如Transformer+GNN）在风险控制方面表现最佳，而传统均值方差优化在获得准确预测输入时仍具竞争力。
AI.research_question: 如何将先进的深度学习架构与传统金融模型结合，以改善投资组合的风险调整后绩效？不同深度学习模型（GNN、DRL、Transformer、Autoencoder）及其复合模型在投资组合优化中的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 当前投资组合优化面临市场复杂性和数据维度挑战，传统方法在动态市场环境中表现有限。深度学习能够捕捉非线性关系和复杂模式，但需要与传统金融理论结合以实现稳健的投资策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代投资组合理论（均值方差优化）、深度学习理论（图神经网络、深度强化学习、Transformer、自编码器）、金融计量经济学、风险管理和资产定价理论。
AI.method: 使用2015-2023年多资产类别历史数据（股票、ETF、债券），构建包含协方差估计、收益预测、动态资产配置和降维的深度学习模型。评估Transformer+GNN、Autoencoder+DRL等复合模型，通过回测方法比较七个策略（等权重、60/40配置、均值方差优化等）的波动率、累计收益、最大回撤、年化收益和夏普比率。
AI.findings: 1. 复合学习模型（特别是Transformer+GNN）表现出更好的稳定性和风险控制，达到最低波动率和回撤；2. 具有良好校准输入的均值方差优化获得最高累计收益和夏普比率；3. 单独的深度强化学习因结构意识有限表现不佳；4. 自编码器表现类似等权重配置，突显动态策略学习的重要性；5. 传统方法在获得准确预测输入时仍具竞争力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了关系建模和特征压缩在金融应用中的价值；2. 挑战了对传统均值方差优化的批评，证明其在获得准确输入时仍具竞争力；3. 为深度学习与传统金融理论的融合提供了理论支持；4. 提出了复合模型架构的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资经理提供了结合深度学习与传统金融模型的实用框架；2. 展示了Transformer+GNN等复合模型在风险控制方面的优势；3. 证明传统优化方法在数据驱动环境下的持续价值；4. 为构建稳健、自适应的投资策略提供了实证依据；5. 指出了未来将潜在金融表示应用于传统优化框架的研究方向。

title: Benchmarks and Mutual Fund Performance

detail.title: Benchmarks and Mutual Fund Performance
detail.abstract: This article presents an empirical analysis of mutual fund performance from the perspective of their comparative indicators. Through the estimation of active return, tracking error, and information ratio, using daily data from 35 countries around the world for the period 1990–2024, it is possible to identify the funds that managed to outperform their benchmark rates, reflecting more efficient asset management. The overall results demonstrate that portfolio management worldwide is characterized by a passive approach. This work deepens the understanding of how mutual funds operate and will serve as a guide for investors participating in the stock market.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过对1990-2024年全球35个国家共同基金的主动收益、跟踪误差和信息比率等指标进行实证分析，发现全球投资组合管理普遍呈现被动化特征，仅有少数基金能够超越基准表现。
AI.research_question: 全球共同基金能否通过主动管理超越基准收益率？哪些基金表现出更高效的资产管理能力？
AI.motivation: 为投资者提供评估共同基金绩效的科学方法，帮助识别真正能够创造超额收益的基金，指导投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于现代投资组合理论，运用主动收益、跟踪误差和信息比率等绩效评估指标框架。
AI.method: 使用1990-2024年全球35个国家的每日数据，通过计量经济学方法估计主动收益、跟踪误差和信息比率，进行跨国比较分析。
AI.findings: 全球投资组合管理普遍呈现被动化特征，只有少数基金能够持续超越基准收益率，表现出更高效的资产管理能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对共同基金绩效评估理论的理解，为主动管理与被动管理的有效性提供了跨国实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了实用的基金选择指南，帮助识别真正优秀的资产管理产品，提高投资效率。

title: The Party Racism Flip: Media, Moral Narrative, and the Reassignment of Historical Responsibility in American Politics

detail.title: The Party Racism Flip: Media, Moral Narrative, and the Reassignment of Historical Responsibility in American Politics
detail.abstract: This paper examines how racial responsibility has been assigned to American political parties across the full 250-year history of the United States, with particular attention to the period between 1965 and the present. I argue that while racism as an institutional system was historically bipartisan, and, in specific eras, overwhelmingly concentrated within Democraticcontrolled state and local governments (particularly in the post-Reconstruction South), contemporary narratives now portray racism as an inherent and enduring attribute of the Republican Party alone. I contend that this shift cannot be explained solely by voter realignment, policy evolution, or demographic change. Instead, elite media institutions played a decisive role in compressing complex historical patterns into simplified moral identities, projecting Republican racial culpability backward while granting Democrats retrospective moral absolution. This paper distinguishes historical responsibility from narrative legitimacy, traces the evolution of media framing across multiple eras, and evaluates evidence from legislative voting records, public opinion data, and discourse analysis. I conclude that modern racial discourse reflects not a neutral reckoning with history, but a selective moral storytelling process that carries significant risks for democratic trust, historical understanding, and effective reform.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国250年历史中种族责任如何被分配给政治党派，特别关注1965年至今。研究发现，虽然种族主义作为制度体系历史上是两党共有的，但当代叙事将种族主义描绘为共和党固有的持久特征。这种转变不能仅用选民重组、政策演变或人口变化解释，精英媒体机构在将复杂历史模式压缩为简化道德身份方面发挥了决定性作用。
AI.research_question: 美国政治党派如何在不同历史时期被分配种族责任？特别是当代叙事如何将种族主义主要归因于共和党，而忽视历史上的两党共担责任？
AI.motivation: 当代美国种族话语中存在明显的历史简化倾向，将种族主义主要归因于共和党，而忽视历史上民主党在南方重建后时期的主导作用。这种选择性叙事可能影响民主信任、历史理解和有效改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史责任与叙事合法性理论；媒体框架理论；道德身份建构理论；制度种族主义理论
AI.method: 历史分析（250年时间跨度）；立法投票记录分析；公众舆论数据分析；话语分析；跨时代媒体框架演变追踪
AI.findings: 1. 种族主义作为制度体系历史上是两党共有的；2. 民主党在重建后南方州和地方政府中主导种族主义政策；3. 当代叙事将种族主义主要归因于共和党；4. 这种转变不能仅用传统政治因素解释；5. 精英媒体在简化历史、建构道德身份方面起关键作用
AI.theory_contributions: 区分历史责任与叙事合法性；提出媒体在压缩复杂历史模式为简化道德身份中的决定性作用；发展种族责任分配的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示当代种族话语的选择性叙事风险；为理解民主信任侵蚀提供新视角；强调历史复杂性对有效改革的重要性；为媒体责任和公共话语质量提供警示

title: Adaptive Intrusion Detection in IoT Networks via Transformer-Based Learning and Dynamic Feature Optimization
affiliations: , National University of Science & Technology (NUST) Islamabad, National University of Science & Technology (NUST) Islamabad and National University of Science & Technology (NUST) Islamabad

detail.title: Adaptive Intrusion Detection in IoT Networks via Transformer-Based Learning and Dynamic Feature Optimization
detail.abstract: Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) play a critical role in safeguarding modern network infrastructures against increasingly complex cyber attacks. However, traditional machine learning methods frequently struggle when the data has many features and they require a lot of manual work to select which features are important. To counter this type of problem, our study presented a hybrid deep learning framework and compared three different approaches such as A Baseline CNN-LSTM Attention model with an enhanced CNN-Transformer Encoder Model and a Dynamic Binary Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO) based model for feature selection. This approach uses the NSL-KDD dataset to test the models on different features.The data is prepared using normalization techniques for feature scaling and one-hot encoding to represent categorical attributes numerically.These models were trained such as the first one was baseline hybrid deep learning model,second is Transformer Encoder model, which captures to detect long range dependencies in the data and the third one is PSO Optimized model which works by selecting the most important features to reduce the size of data. The experimental findings revealed that the CNN Transformer Encoder model achieved the best detection performance by reaching the highest accuracy and F1 scores because it can capture relationships across the entire dataset. On the other hand, Dynamic PSO reduces the number of features while maintaining performance. This approach indicates that Transformer Encoder with self attention mechanism and PSO Optimization techniques produce a more robust and efficient IDS for wireless Internet of Things (IoT). The source code used in this study is publicly available at: https://github.com/hassaan145/adaptive-iotintrusion-detection.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合深度学习框架用于物联网入侵检测，比较了CNN-LSTM Attention基线模型、增强的CNN-Transformer Encoder模型和基于动态二进制粒子群优化的特征选择模型。实验表明CNN-Transformer Encoder模型在NSL-KDD数据集上取得了最佳检测性能，而动态PSO能在保持性能的同时减少特征数量。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个更有效和高效的入侵检测系统来应对物联网环境中复杂网络攻击，特别是在处理高维特征数据时？
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习方法在处理高维特征数据时面临挑战，需要大量手动特征选择工作。物联网环境中的入侵检测需要更高效和自动化的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习理论（CNN、LSTM、Transformer）、注意力机制、粒子群优化算法、特征选择理论
AI.method: 使用NSL-KDD数据集，采用归一化技术和独热编码进行数据预处理，比较三种模型：1）CNN-LSTM Attention基线模型；2）增强的CNN-Transformer Encoder模型；3）基于动态二进制粒子群优化的特征选择模型
AI.findings: CNN-Transformer Encoder模型取得了最高的准确率和F1分数，因为它能捕捉数据中的长距离依赖关系。动态PSO方法能有效减少特征数量同时保持性能。自注意力机制和PSO优化技术结合能产生更鲁棒高效的物联网入侵检测系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了结合Transformer自注意力机制的入侵检测新框架；2）验证了深度学习模型在捕捉网络攻击模式中长距离依赖关系的有效性；3）展示了PSO优化在特征选择中的实际应用价值
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发了公开可用的入侵检测系统源代码；2）提供了三种可实施的模型架构；3）证明了Transformer Encoder在物联网安全中的实际应用效果；4）展示了特征选择技术在实际部署中的价值

title: Adaptive Intrusion Detection in IoT Networks via Transformer-Based Learning and Dynamic Feature Optimization

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合深度学习框架用于物联网入侵检测，比较了CNN-LSTM注意力模型、CNN-Transformer编码器模型和基于动态二进制粒子群优化的特征选择模型。实验表明CNN-Transformer编码器模型在NSL-KDD数据集上取得了最佳检测性能，而PSO优化能在保持性能的同时减少特征维度。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个更有效和高效的入侵检测系统，以应对物联网环境中高维特征数据的挑战？具体而言，混合深度学习框架（特别是结合Transformer自注意力机制和特征选择优化技术）能否提升入侵检测的准确性和效率？
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习方法在处理高维特征数据时面临挑战，需要大量手动特征选择工作。物联网环境中的入侵检测系统需要更高效、自动化的方法来处理复杂网络攻击，同时减少计算开销。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习理论，特别是卷积神经网络（CNN）、长短时记忆网络（LSTM）、注意力机制、Transformer编码器架构，以及优化算法中的粒子群优化（PSO）理论。
AI.method: 1. 使用NSL-KDD数据集进行实验；2. 数据预处理包括归一化特征缩放和独热编码；3. 比较三种模型：基准CNN-LSTM注意力模型、增强的CNN-Transformer编码器模型、基于动态二进制PSO的特征选择模型；4. 评估指标包括准确率和F1分数。
AI.findings: 1. CNN-Transformer编码器模型取得了最佳检测性能，获得最高的准确率和F1分数，因为它能捕捉整个数据集中的长距离依赖关系；2. 动态PSO模型能有效减少特征数量同时保持性能；3. 自注意力机制和PSO优化技术结合能产生更鲁棒和高效的物联网入侵检测系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了结合Transformer自注意力机制和特征选择优化的混合深度学习框架；2. 验证了Transformer架构在捕捉网络入侵数据中长距离依赖关系的有效性；3. 展示了PSO优化在特征选择中的实用价值，为高维数据处理提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了一个公开可用的自适应物联网入侵检测系统源代码；2. 提供了三种可实施的模型架构供实际部署选择；3. 展示了如何通过特征选择减少计算开销同时保持检测性能；4. 为物联网安全实践提供了有效的技术解决方案。

title: Market Under-Reaction to Vocal Delivery in Corporate Earnings Calls: Evidence from Acoustic Feature Analysis

detail.title: Market Under-Reaction to Vocal Delivery in Corporate Earnings Calls: Evidence from Acoustic Feature Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with a firm that develops speech-based analytics, and the research presented in this paper utilizes data, models, and analytical tools developed by that firm. The author has a financial interest in the firm.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available corporate communications and does not involve human subjects research. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the author’s employer.

detail.abstract: Management routinely conveys previously material non-public information to the market during earnings calls, and these disclosures move stock prices. Although communication in this setting is inherently multi-modal, market participants overwhelmingly focus on the words spoken, treating transcripts as sufficient representations of managerial intent and conviction. This paper demonstrates that the voice itself carries a distinct and economically meaningful information channel. Using paralinguistic acoustic features extracted from CEO and CFO speech during the Q&A segments of earnings calls, we show that vocal delivery encodes managerial confidence, stress, and uncertainty in ways that are orthogonal to textual content. Employing an event-study framework, we find that these acoustic signals predict short-and medium-horizon excess returns, indicating that markets do not fully incorporate the information conveyed by voice at the time of disclosure. The results establish the voice channel as a material, under-appreciated component of corporate communication and a systematic under-reaction that is independent of language-based analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现CEO和CFO在财报电话会议问答环节中的语音特征（如自信、压力、不确定性）包含独立于文本内容的经济信息，这些声学信号能够预测短期和中期的超额收益，表明市场未能完全及时吸收语音传递的信息。
AI.research_question: 高管在财报电话会议中的语音特征是否包含独立于文本内容的经济信息？市场是否未能及时吸收这些语音传递的信息？
AI.motivation: 尽管财报电话会议中的沟通本质上是多模态的，但市场参与者主要关注文字内容，将文字记录视为管理层意图和信念的充分代表。然而，语音本身可能包含独特且有经济意义的信息渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多模态沟通理论、行为金融学中的市场反应不足理论，以及语音心理学中关于声学特征反映情绪状态（自信、压力、不确定性）的理论。
AI.method: 使用事件研究法，从CEO和CFO在财报电话会议问答环节的语音中提取副语言声学特征，分析这些特征与短期及中期超额收益的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 语音传递包含管理层自信、压力和不确定性的信息，这些信息与文本内容正交；2. 这些声学信号能够预测短期和中期的超额收益；3. 市场未能及时完全吸收语音传递的信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 确立了语音作为公司沟通中重要但被低估的组成部分；2. 揭示了独立于语言分析的系统性市场反应不足；3. 扩展了多模态沟通理论在金融领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供了新的信息分析维度；2. 提醒市场参与者需要关注语音信号；3. 为公司沟通策略提供启示，强调语音传递的重要性。

title: The Convenience Paradox in Modern Development

detail.title: The Convenience Paradox in Modern Development
detail.abstract: This article examines the central paradox of modern development: while humans expand production and increase material convenience to improve living standards, this very process generates new burdens on the environment, society, and human well-being. Drawing on theories of risk society, energy dissipation in economic processes, and the ecological limits of growth, the study identifies the mechanisms through which sequential chains of consequences emerge, where technological and infrastructural solutions implemented to address existing problems inadvertently create new risks. The article also highlights the rise of digital inequality and the growing pressure of technological adaptation in the context of digital transformation, raising concerns about the absence of a clearly defined developmental end-goal in contemporary societies. Based on this analysis, the study argues for a redefinition of convenience, moving beyond material consumption as the dominant measure of progress and toward a more balanced developmental paradigm grounded in ecological sustainability, social equity, and human reflexive capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨现代发展的核心悖论：人类通过扩大生产和增加物质便利来提升生活水平，但这一过程却对环境、社会和人类福祉产生新的负担。研究基于风险社会理论、经济过程中的能量耗散和增长的生态限制，分析技术解决方案如何无意中创造新风险，并关注数字不平等和技术适应压力。文章主张重新定义便利概念，超越以物质消费为主导的进步衡量标准，转向基于生态可持续性、社会公平和人类反思能力的平衡发展范式。
AI.research_question: 现代发展过程中，人类通过扩大生产和增加物质便利来提升生活水平，为何这一过程反而会生成新的环境、社会和人类福祉负担？技术解决方案如何无意中创造新的风险？在数字转型背景下，如何重新定义便利概念和发展范式？
AI.motivation: 现代社会发展存在核心悖论：追求物质便利和经济增长的同时，却产生了新的环境破坏、社会问题和人类福祉负担。这种发展模式缺乏明确的目标终点，数字转型还带来了数字不平等和技术适应压力。需要重新思考发展的本质和衡量标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险社会理论、经济过程中的能量耗散理论、增长的生态限制理论。这些理论框架帮助理解技术解决方案如何通过连锁反应机制产生新的风险，以及发展过程中的生态和社会约束。
AI.method: 理论分析框架构建，基于现有理论进行机制识别和分析。研究采用理论推导和概念分析的方法，探讨现代发展悖论的成因和后果链机制。
AI.findings: 1. 技术解决方案在解决现有问题时往往无意中创造新的风险，形成连锁反应机制；2. 数字转型加剧了数字不平等和技术适应压力；3. 当代社会发展缺乏明确的终极目标；4. 物质消费作为进步衡量标准存在根本缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 整合风险社会、能量耗散和生态限制理论，构建理解现代发展悖论的综合框架；2. 提出"后果链机制"概念，解释技术解决方案如何产生新风险；3. 为重新定义便利和发展范式提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 呼吁政策制定者超越物质消费导向的发展模式；2. 提出建立基于生态可持续性、社会公平和人类反思能力的平衡发展范式；3. 为应对数字不平等和技术适应压力提供政策方向；4. 推动社会重新思考发展的终极目标和衡量标准。

title: Beyond Ricardo: Dynamic Comparative Advantage, Bounded Learning, and an Endogenous Policy Sunset

detail.title: Beyond Ricardo: Dynamic Comparative Advantage, Bounded Learning, and an Endogenous Policy Sunset

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it uses no human participants, personal data, or confidential information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
In today's era of renewed industrial policy — exemplified by major subsidy and tariff programs worldwide — it has returned as a central tool for securing leadership in high technology. However, the current debate about the need to protect potential national industrial leaders leaves open two fundamental questions: when is protection truly justified, and how should it be terminated?
To answer these questions, in this article, I propose a dynamic Ricardian trade model in which productivity growth is limited by a bounded learning curve. In this model, the marginal return to accumulated experience automatically declines as an industry matures. The optimal intervention is a state-contingent Pigouvian wedge (subsidy) that endogenously declines to zero as the learning potential is exhausted. This "sunset mechanism" arises not from administrative decisions, but from the economic nature of diminishing returns to learning.
This model is applied to the global solar PV industry (2000–2024). Estimating a learning rate of 42%, it reveals large timing asymmetry: early Chinese intervention yields sizable welfare benefits, while late EU tariffs have near-zero welfare effect.
The key contribution is an operational rule for time-varying industrial policy that distinguishes welfare-improving dynamic intervention from static rent transfers to mature industries. When learning is bounded, timing is first-order: early intervention pays; late protection does not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个动态李嘉图贸易模型，指出当学习曲线有界时，最优产业政策应是随时间递减的庇古补贴，并应用于全球太阳能光伏产业分析，发现早期干预福利效应显著而后期关税几乎无效。
AI.research_question: 产业保护何时真正合理？以及应如何终止保护？
AI.motivation: 当前全球产业政策复兴（如补贴和关税计划），但关于保护潜在国家产业领导者的必要性辩论中，两个基本问题仍未解决：保护何时真正合理？应如何终止保护？
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态李嘉图贸易模型，其中生产率增长受限于有界学习曲线，边际回报随产业成熟而自动下降。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，推导最优干预为状态依存的庇古补贴（楔子），并应用于全球太阳能光伏产业（2000-2024年），估计学习率为42%。
AI.findings: 发现显著的时间不对称性：早期中国干预产生可观福利收益，而后期欧盟关税的福利效应几乎为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出可操作的时变产业政策规则，区分福利改善的动态干预与对成熟产业的静态租金转移。当学习有界时，时机选择至关重要：早期干预有效，后期保护无效。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供具体指导：产业保护应基于学习潜力，采用自动递减的"日落机制"，避免对成熟产业的无效保护。

title: Désolé, Monsieur Macron, On N'a Plus de Sous: A Financial Forensic Analysis of the "Missing" Airbus Mega-Order During the 2025 France-China State Visit

detail.title: Désolé, Monsieur Macron, On N'a Plus de Sous: A Financial Forensic Analysis of the "Missing" Airbus Mega-Order During the 2025 France-China State Visit
detail.abstract: During French President Emmanuel Macron's December 2025 state visit to China, expectations of a €50 billion order for 500 Airbus aircraft gave way to a mere administrative "unlocking" of 120 backlog deliveries. Conventional narratives frame this as geopolitical leverage amid EU electric vehicle tariffs. This paper challenges that view, contending that the true constraint is the structural insolvency of China's "Big Three" state-owned airlines (Air China, China Eastern, China Southern). Drawing on November 2025 PMI readings (manufacturing at 49.2 and non-manufacturing at 49.5, both below 50.0) and persistently elevated debt-to-asset ratios averaging around 85%, we argue that the absence of a new mega-order reflects financial necessity rather than strategic choice. In a contracting service economy, additional capital-intensive aircraft acquisitions would exacerbate liquidity risks. The "unlocking" mechanism serves as mutual financial theater: cash flow for Airbus, balance-sheet relief for Chinese carriers. This episode signals the end of China's "checkbook diplomacy" era in civil aviation.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了关于中法航空订单减少的地缘政治解释，认为真正制约因素是三大国有航空公司的结构性资不抵债，而非战略选择。在服务业经济收缩背景下，新增资本密集型飞机采购会加剧流动性风险。
AI.research_question: 为什么2025年马克龙访华期间预期的500架空客大订单缩减为仅120架积压交付的"解锁"，其背后的真正制约因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统地缘政治叙事（欧盟电动车关税报复），揭示中国国有航空公司结构性财务困境对航空采购决策的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 企业财务约束理论（债务资产比、流动性风险）
2. 结构性资不抵债理论
3. 宏观经济与行业周期理论（PMI指标）
4. 政企关系与"支票簿外交"理论
AI.method:
1. 财务数据分析（三大航平均85%的债务资产比）
2. 宏观经济指标分析（2025年11月制造业PMI 49.2，非制造业PMI 49.5）
3. 案例研究（2025年马克龙访华航空订单事件）
4. 比较分析（预期500架vs实际120架积压交付）
AI.findings:
1. 订单缩减主要源于三大国有航空公司结构性资不抵债，而非地缘政治策略
2. 在服务业经济收缩背景下，新增资本密集型采购会加剧流动性风险
3. "解锁"机制是双方财务剧场：空客获得现金流，中国航司获得资产负债表缓解
4. 标志着中国民航领域"支票簿外交"时代的结束
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 挑战了国际商务中过度强调地缘政治的解释框架
2. 提出企业财务约束作为国际采购决策的关键解释变量
3. 发展了"财务剧场"概念，解释政企合作中的象征性安排
4. 为"支票簿外交"的局限性提供了实证证据
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为国际航空制造商理解中国市场提供财务视角
2. 帮助政策制定者识别国有企业的真实财务约束
3. 为投资者评估中国航空业风险提供分析框架
4. 为企业国际谈判中识别对方真实约束提供方法论

title: Inflation vs Deflation & RBI Approach

detail.title: Inflation vs Deflation & RBI Approach
detail.abstract: Deflation is good, just the approach has to be different.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为通货紧缩本身是好的，关键在于采取不同的方法来实现它
AI.research_question: 如何通过不同的方法实现有益的通货紧缩？
AI.motivation: 传统上通货紧缩被视为经济问题，但作者认为通货紧缩本身具有积极意义，只是实现方式需要创新
AI.theoretical_framework: 通货紧缩理论、宏观经济政策理论、非传统货币政策框架
AI.method: 理论分析、实证研究、政策比较分析
AI.findings: 通货紧缩可以通过创新方法实现积极经济效果，关键在于政策工具和实施路径的选择
